project.title: Aquascape substrates v2
project.description: Four independently generated full-resolution substrate textures added to the accepted warm fine sand experiment. Local material painting and batched surface gravel, retaining two existing large rock models.
project.art_direction: Match the accepted warm sand reference and established naturalistic pixel aquarium artwork. Different materials must remain distinct in hue, grain shape and grain scale.
project.gameplay_loop: Select a substrate and locally pour or repaint patches; mixed substrate boundaries, height edits, batched gravel and persistence.
project.session_goal: Five total substrate types with local mixing, granular surface instances for gravel, native scale/performance checks and trial review.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1024x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: quartz_white
asset.description: Create ONE seamless tileable aquarium substrate material, exact straight-down orthographic view of a flat densely packed surface, full bleed square 1024x1024. Match the supplied accepted sand illustration for fine deliberate PIXEL ART clusters, naturalistic painted material, controlled palette and readable grains. No photo, no smooth CGI, no uniform procedural noise. No borders, labels, inset, plants, fish, equipment, large rocks, sand hills or white studio background. All four image edges should tile continuously. Broad overall even color, no large blobs, no directional gradients, no large cast shadows. Very subtle diffuse grain shading; later real geometry supplies larger shadows. Warm ivory-white quartz aquarium sand. Clearly pale ivory rather than yellow beige; a few very pale gray and translucent quartz grains, delicate cool gray separations, no pure white blown-out areas. Fine rounded irregular mineral grains mostly 2-5 pixels across. Restrained low contrast and no large pebbles.
